content.title: Secure Your Home Internet Today, Before It's Too Late
content.subtitle: Make the Right Decision at the Right Time as a Responsible Parent.
content.body:
Three out of every five school-going students around you are addicted to pornography. This figure comes from research conducted two years ago. The number is likely even higher today. Is your child among those three?

When children use phones at home, are they always viewing appropriate content? Could a pornographic or gambling website ever appear on their screens?

What if unwanted and harmful websites could be blocked directly from the Wi-Fi router used by all the phones, laptops, tablets, and smart TVs in your home?

And what if it also offered:

  • The ability to block pornography, gambling, and harmful websites.

  • Options to enable SafeSearch and YouTube Restricted Mode.

  • Internet usage time limits for children.

  • Schedules to turn off internet access during study and bedtime.

  • Separate controls for every device in the family.

This would help create a safer digital environment while allowing everyone to enjoy the freedom of using the internet.

A New Initiative to Make Your Home Wi-Fi Safer

With this vision, Kahf Router BURAQ 6 is coming to the market.

It is designed not just to provide high-speed Wi-Fi, but also to make your family's internet experience safer and more controlled.

With BURAQ 6, you get:

  1. The ability to block more than 8 million harmful websites.

  2. Network-level filtering of pornography, gambling, and other harmful websites.

  3. Options to set Safe Mode, usage time limits, and bedtime schedules for your children's devices.

  4. The ability to manage your home Wi-Fi and connected devices directly from your phone through a dedicated mobile app.

VPN and Proxy Control

Options to block selected VPN and Proxy connections, reducing the risk of bypassing network security measures.
